model.title: Chesapeake Bay Watershed Advancement for Training, Education, Restoration, and Science (WATERS) Act
model.meta: Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Robert Scott (D-VA)

summary.text: The bill would reauthorize the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration's Chesapeake Bay Office and establish new consultation requirements for its operations. It would also provide legal authority for the office's education and training programs in schools and create a new program to support the management, protection, and restoration of important Chesapeake Bay habitats and living resources.
